import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

# Job data
jobs = {
    0: {"processing_time": 74, "due_date": 274, "weight": 4},
    1: {"processing_time": 87, "due_date": 153, "weight": 1},
    2: {"processing_time": 40, "due_date": 371, "weight": 6},
    3: {"processing_time": 54, "due_date": 749, "weight": 8},
    4: {"processing_time": 23, "due_date": 319, "weight": 9},
    5: {"processing_time": 60, "due_date": 162, "weight": 5},
    6: {"processing_time": 94, "due_date": 624, "weight": 2},
    7: {"processing_time": 8, "due_date": 820, "weight": 1},
    8: {"processing_time": 65, "due_date": 851, "weight": 5},
    9: {"processing_time": 80, "due_date": 929, "weight": 10},
    10: {"processing_time": 38, "due_date": 463, "weight": 7},
    11: {"processing_time": 19, "due_date": 493, "weight": 10},
    12: {"processing_time": 97, "due_date": 913, "weight": 2},
    13: {"processing_time": 62, "due_date": 211, "weight": 8},
    14: {"processing_time": 45, "due_date": 574, "weight": 2},
    15: {"processing_time": 29, "due_date": 598, "weight": 6},
    16: {"processing_time": 85, "due_date": 698, "weight": 8},
    17: {"processing_time": 53, "due_date": 266, "weight": 7},
    18: {"processing_time": 55, "due_date": 525, "weight": 2},
    19: {"processing_time": 6, "due_date": 559, "weight": 8},
    20: {"processing_time": 69, "due_date": 449, "weight": 3},
    21: {"processing_time": 85, "due_date": 560, "weight": 7},
    22: {"processing_time": 30, "due_date": 433, "weight": 10},
    23: {"processing_time": 78, "due_date": 324, "weight": 3},
    24: {"processing_time": 9, "due_date": 199, "weight": 5},
}

# Create a new model
model = gp.Model("single_machine_scheduling")
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0

# Number of jobs
n = len(jobs)

# Variables
C = model.addVars(n, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="C")  # Completion times
T = model.addVars(n, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="T")  # Tardiness
x = model.addVars(n, n, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="x")   # Sequencing variables

# Objective: Minimize weighted sum of tardiness
model.setObjective(gp.quicksum(jobs[j]["weight"] * T[j] for j in range(n)), GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Constraints
# Completion time constraints
for j in range(n):
    model.addConstr(C[j] >= jobs[j]["processing_time"] + gp.quicksum(jobs[i]["processing_time"] * x[i, j] for i in range(n) if i != j))

# Tardiness constraints
for j in range(n):
    model.addConstr(T[j] >= C[j] - jobs[j]["due_date"])

# Sequencing constraints
for i in range(n):
    model.addConstr(gp.quicksum(x[i, j] for j in range(n) if i != j) == 1)
    model.addConstr(gp.quicksum(x[j, i] for j in range(n) if i != j) == 1)

# Solve the model
model.optimize()

# Extract the sequence
sequence = sorted(range(n), key=lambda j: C[j].X)

# Output the result
result = {
    "sequence": sequence,
    "objective_value": model.ObjVal
}

import json
print(json.dumps(result))
